meta.name: repo-intake-and-plan
meta.description: Rigor Intake helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to scan a repository, read the README and common project files, extract documented commands, classify inference, evaluation, and training candidates, and return the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan to the main orchestrator. Do not use for environment setup, asset download, command execution, final reporting, paper lookup, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫一遍仓库的说明与配置文件,列出一份最靠谱的最小复现步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到一个开源深度学习仓库,想先弄清怎么跑起来再动手
copy.tagline_en: Scan a repo's docs and files, then list the shortest reproduction steps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an open-source deep learning repo and want to know how to run it.

howto.what: 装上后,面对一个深度学习仓库的复现任务,Claude 会扫描仓库、读 README 和常见项目文件,列出文档里写明的命令,把它们分为推理、评测、训练等候选类别,并给出一份最小可信的复现建议和风险清单。它只扫描和规划,不装环境、不执行命令。
howto.when: 在 README 优先的复现工作开始时触发:需要快速摸清仓库结构和文档命令、要保守地把推理/评测/训练候选分类,或用户想先看仓库、暂不执行任何东西时。

say.text: 先扫一遍这个仓库,把 README 里的命令列出来
say.note: 会返回仓库结构摘要和命令清单

say.text: 帮我把能推理、评测、训练的候选命令分个类
say.note: 给出分类结果与最小复现建议

say.text: 先别跑任何东西,只给我一份最小的复现计划
say.note: 输出复现建议,并列出歧义和风险

howto.what_en: For repo reproduction tasks, Claude scans the repo, reads the README and project files, lists documented commands, sorts them into inference, evaluation, training or other, and returns a short trustworthy plan. It installs or runs nothing.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of README-first reproduction work, or when the user wants to inspect a repo before running anything; it classifies inference, evaluation and training candidates.

say_en.text: Scan this repo and list the commands in its README.
say_en.note: Returns a structure summary and command inventory.

say_en.text: Sort the candidate commands into inference, evaluation and training.
say_en.note: Gives categories and a minimal reproduction plan.

say_en.text: Don't run anything yet; just give me a minimal reproduction plan.
say_en.note: Returns the plan plus ambiguity and risk list.
